title: Not quite what I expected.
text: Not quite what I expected.. This is the 3rd artificial tree I've owned so I feel like I have a good idea on how they compare. There are several things I like and several I don't. The first is the large box it's shipped in. It really is a pain to have to force the tree back into a teensy box to store it. I don't mind if it takes up a little more room. Next, the metal base with this tree is far superior to that of trees in my Christmas past and it's super easy to open and close to store. The little little tightening bolts are nice too. The assembly is a breeze. Each of the 3 sections are clearly marked. You'll want do cut those tags off before using. But the graduated size of the sections are easily to see. You will not need the tags to guide you. The amount of branches on the tree are just ok. From the picture it looks really full and that the pine needles start almost from the trunk of tree. NOPE. Each branch has a good 6" before pine needle action. That was a bummer. However, each branch fluffed out really pretty and easy. Better than any tree I've owned. The bottom 2 sections have hinged branches. The top has thick, flexible wire. The top section also is very dense AND sturdy enough to hold a star. I was looking forward to a 7.5 foot tree. That would be 89 inches. This tree is 80 inches. Maybe you could fluff 1 extra inch at the top. Even then, max height is 81 inches, which is 6'9". It's a massive misrepresentation of the product. This is the biggest reason I gave it 3 stars.  The flocking is very subtle. I could take or leave it. But hardly notice it. The pine cones are 100% real and tied on with craft wire. My kids love them. I may remove them after using this year. All in all it's fine. Not what I was hoping for in both height and fluffiness.
